blocking_focus: Complete the candidate-bound Tester MCP state matrix.

preservation_constraints.requirement: Keep frozen technical baseline `native_godot_project` passing. Do not treat this as a mandate to preserve the same visible asset, map, HUD family, or material choice if a higher-quality replacement is available and the PRD still fits.

Keep frozen technical baseline `host_godot_boot` passing. Do not treat this as a mandate to preserve the same visible asset, map, HUD family, or material choice if a higher-quality replacement is available and the PRD still fits.

acceptance_requirements: Preserve the full frozen R01 requirement for three traversable maps and the full R02 locomotion and equipment-presentation requirement; this increment does not establish either complete criterion.
Retain verified WASD movement, mouse look, shoulder switching, wall collision, mouse release and recapture, Godot boot, and project validity.
Judge new behavior through ordinary input, candidate-bound runtime state, logs, and shipped-camera frames.
deferred_items: The remaining two maps, chapter boundaries, and unimplemented R02 actions remain required after this bounded increment.
Milestone 02 backlog checks receive no task or target in this iteration.
implied_completion: A map route must be reachable at player scale with usable collision and visible landmarks; an imported asset or scene declaration alone is insufficient.
The four allocated issue records remain individually open unless Tester obtains evidence for their specific outcomes.
mandatory_objectives: Treat pinned m01-maps-absent by establishing and testing the first chapter route.
Make one small, observable step toward closing the required R02 gap.
Inspect and retest both active visual issues on the same player and route without treating inspection as a fix.
task_specification.objective: Create a playable river-village route and an independently observable jump, while preserving existing movement and measuring the known camera and character-view defects.

diagnosis.root_cause: The candidate has a single enclosed movement scene. Its player script has no jump, sprint, dodge, roll, or locomotion animation path; prior live views also show camera cropping at wall contact and a face that protrudes from the ranger hood.

stop_conditions: Do not claim the three-map issue or full R02 criterion passed from this two-condition increment.
If ordinary-input replay or shipped-camera capture is unavailable, report the affected condition as lacking evidence.
Keep camera cropping and face integration active if their reproduction views still show the defects.

strategy.rationale: The host permits one cohesive increment and at most two new conditions. A first chapter route addresses the pinned map blocker, and one physical jump cycle provides a measurable R02 advance without bundling the remaining controls into an untestable condition.

code: Check Godot import and script errors, Space binding, native project validity, and host boot.
Inspect exact bound map assets and authoritative movement state; source declarations are supporting evidence only.
runtime: Host and Tester traverse the fresh-start village route to its landmark and back through ordinary input.
Replay one physical Space jump and compare position, velocity, floor state, and pose from takeoff through landing.
Retest previously passing WASD, mouse look, Tab, Esc, recapture, and wall collision; leave the full R02 check failed or unverified until its remaining requirements are measured.
visual: Capture route start, landmark, boundary, and return in the shipped camera.
Capture wall-contact turns from both shoulders and ranger front and side views; report camera cropping and face integration separately.

done_when: From a fresh start, ordinary movement reaches a recognizable river-village route from its safe starting area to a bridge or training landmark and back, with solid route collision and candidate-bound frames at the start, landmark, boundary, and return.

A physical Space press on that route produces one visible jump takeoff, airborne displacement, and landing with a matching player pose; before-and-after position, velocity, floor state, and shipped-camera frames support the observation.
tasks.instructions: Use PRD §§3.1, 5.2, 8.1, 10.2 and R01/R02 with all four allocated issue records. Inspect the current scene at character scale before placing the route. Compare bounded local village resources with external candidates only under Developer authority; qualify source, license, geometry, materials, texture scale, import, and actual binding. Keep visible art consistent with the PRD and record applicable asset-family diversity and representative views. Consult registered Godot documentation for the chosen movement, collision, animation, camera, and renderer capabilities. Preserve the prior passing controls. Reproduce wall-contact turns on both shoulders and front and side ranger views; make a bounded repair if supported by evidence, and report either remaining defect honestly. Do not claim three-map, sprint, dodge, roll, equipment-presentation, or milestone completion from the new route and jump.

investigation.expected_observation: A complete authored village environment has a coherent player-scale route and materials; a modular kit needs composed route work and live collision checks.
investigation.hypothesis: The indexed village resource is a kit rather than a complete traversable chapter map.
investigation.probe: Inspect one bounded village candidate for layout, scale, material quality, and Godot import, then walk its proposed route in the shipped camera.

research_assessment.reason: The available map entries do not establish a complete route, and jump, wall-camera, and face behavior need live player-scale observation.
research_assessment.target_capability: First-chapter spatial route and physical jump in the pinned Godot runtime

risk_note.summary: A visible route or input binding may still lack evidence of a completed player journey.
risk_note.validation: Replay physical movement to the landmark and back, then Space through takeoff and landing; capture runtime state, logs, and shipped-camera frames, including the known wall and face views.
risk_note.why_now: The prior review observed only an enclosure and measured Space as producing no jump.
